rationale: All six background propositions retain their original epistemic strength and citation attachment: “can increase” remains with Rahmani and Okeke & Vidal; “may shape” remains with Sato; “can improve…without improving” remains with Dlamini & Kroll; “has been associated” remains with Petrescu; and “may signal” remains with Al-Masri & Ko. No citation was dropped, merged, misattributed, or attached to the current findings. The added mapping preserves “was associated with” for cross-cutting replies and “predicted” for hostile tone. Condensation, thematic organization, and the explicit results link are authorized by R-1 and R-2.
